tables.title: Pet rules
rows: Pets start at Tier 1. A pet must be level 50 to tier up, and its level resets to 1 afterwards. Needs 150, 350, 700, 1,200 then 1,850 food points per step.
A sacrificed pet gives 51–100 points as an ungraded (Slyme) pet, 101–150 at Tier 1, 151–200 at Tier 2, 251–300 at Tier 3, 401–450 at Tier 4, 601–650 at Tier 5 and 851–900 at Tier 6.
Slymes (Act 2 town egg) are food only and cannot be tiered up. Rare Slymes give no extra without the Engineer feeding upgrades.

At Tier 5–6 one of the two secondary stats can be rerolled for gems; the price rises with pet tier (EvitaniaOnlineDB's calculator uses 200 gems at Tier V). Unverified until checked in game. The result is random.

A pet gets 1 XP for each item it picks up, however large the stack. Pickup has a cooldown that shrinks as it levels (4 seconds at first, none from level 40), so early levels cannot be rushed. The guide's figures are about 6 hours for levels 1–40 and at least 8 more hours to 50, from before a later rebalance. Chopping wood at full speed is a steady item supply.
A pet levels only by picking up loot while equipped. Canned Knowledge potions come on monthly login days 5 and 6.
Keep the main pet on your fastest farmer.
A food pet levelled to 50 before it is fed gives 50 more points; Slymes also get the Engineer feeding bonus.
Sets a pet to level 50 at once; it must pick up one item for the level to count.
The Act 2 town egg hatches a Slyme every 16 hours. A Slyme has two stats; other pets have four.
The rerolled secondary stat comes from: All EXP, Offline Gains, Mob Spawn Time, Woodcutting Power, Crit Damage.
Pets cannot be deleted; feed an unwanted one into a level 50 pet. Mony cannot be fed.
150 gems changes a pet's look only.
